svg.title: BlastLab hosted Web Chamber execution
svg.desc: Developer agent source executes in one restricted Vultr container. A separate controller-owned Chromium container reads synthetic hostile pages. The trusted controller mediates fixed page reads and Vultr inference, keeps credentials outside both workers, and verifies removal of both containers before releasing the report. This is an explanatory architecture diagram, not live telemetry.

g.text: BLAST/LAB · THE WEB
ARCHITECTURE / NOT TELEMETRY
VULTR SERVERLESS INFERENCE
Task-specific attack planning + target-agent model calls
VULTR COMPUTE / CONTROLLER AND ISOLATED WORKERS
TRUSTED CAMPAIGN CONTROLLER
Provider keys stay here · bounded capabilities · lifecycle owner
AGENT CASES / INFERENCE / PAGE READ BRIDGE
FIXED PAGE / DOM OBSERVATIONS
DISPOSABLE AGENT CONTAINER
Your uploaded agent
Your decision logic · legitimate mission · declared tool intents
No external network, host mounts or provider credentials
SEPARATE CONTROLLED BROWSER CONTAINER
Chromium / synthetic webpage
Fixed /specimen route · escaped hostile page note
No public browsing · scripts disabled · fresh context per read
BOTH WORKERS REMOVED → VERIFIED REPORT RELEASE
Report: browser reads + source/page fingerprints + numeric mission result + policy findings + exact replay.
Internal agent side effects remain unverified. Fresh execution is not mission recovery after compromise.
TOOLCHAIN · THE VAULT · THE MACHINE · CHAOS — PLANNED / NOT RUNNABLE
